notes.title: Update v0.31 – New UI Features & Improvements
notes.content:
With version 0.31 we’re bringing important quality-of-life features and technical improvements to the game. This update focuses on a more user-friendly interface, more stable gameplay, and a more realistic flight experience.


New
Trade UI redesigned
Cleaner and easier to use.
Added “Sell All” and “Buy All” buttons for faster trading.

Loot UI upgrade
You can now loot everything with a single button.

Reverse flight adjusted
For added realism, reverse speed is now limited to 30% of normal speed.


Updated
Code improvements to prevent UI-related crashes.

Improved planet spawner for more variety in sectors.

Loot UI now closes automatically when no items remain.

Mining UI now closes automatically when no resources remain.


Bug Fix
Tutorial bug fixed: If you cancel the tutorial, it will no longer start automatically.

notes.title: Update v0.30: Performance & Stability
notes.content:
New

Performance improvements for objects in sectors, resulting in reduced CPU load.

Updated

Sector loading is now more stable.

More efficient memory management for UI image files such as icons.

Bug Fixes

Various minor fixes.

Particle system issues during movement have been resolved.

The waypoint indicator now disappears correctly when switching to keyboard control.

notes.title: Update v0.29 — Waypoints & Sector Map Refresh
notes.content:
TL;DR: Set single & chained waypoints, visible sector borders on map & minimap, refreshed sector map, better danger-level distribution at higher sensor ranges, more scannable objects — plus bug fixes.
New
Waypoints on the Sector Map

Create waypoint: Right Mouse Button (RMB).

Create multiple waypoints quickly: Hold Shift + RMB.

Auto-navigation: Your ship automatically heads to the next waypoint as soon as one is placed.

Visible sector borders on Sector Map and Minimap.
Updated
Icons added to the Home Sector menu.

Sector Map redesigned for better clarity and planning.

Improved danger-level distribution for discovered sectors:

With Sensor Range 5 you’ll see more Danger Level 4 sectors.

With Sensor Range 6 you’ll see mostly Danger Level 5 sectors.

More objects can be scanned within a sector.
Bug Fixes
Fixed translation display issues in the Extraction UI.

Fixed UI rendering for selected containers.
[hr][/hr]Pro tip: Fast route planning with waypoints[olist]
Open the Sector Map.

RMB on any position to place a waypoint.

Hold Shift + RMB repeatedly to chain a route.

The ship auto-follows the newest waypoint and works through the chain.
[/olist]
Thanks for all the feedback—keep it coming, and enjoy exploring! 🚀

notes.title: Hotfix 0.28.4 – Research Tooltip Costs Fixed
notes.content:
Hotfix: Research costs in tooltips are now accurate

TL;DR: A display bug caused the research tooltips to show ship/system costs while the Buy button correctly checked the ResearchItem costs (credits + resources). This made entries like Pulse laser or Argo Freighter A look “green” but not actually purchasable. Fixed now.



What changed

 Minor cleanup in tooltip text blocks.

notes.title: Update – Research & Galactic Market Bugfixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
today’s update brings two important fixes based on your feedback:
Bugfixes
Galactic Market unlock

The Galactic Market can now be properly unlocked and built after Research Level 2.

Tooltips now display all required costs (credits and resources) before purchase.

After purchase, the research card turns purple (researched), the Market room appears in the station build menu, and once built, the Galactic Trade button in the main menu becomes active.

Research tooltip colors

Resource requirements on the research panel now correctly display in red/green instead of all white.

This makes it clearer which resources are available and which are missing.
Note
The current border color system (orange/green/purple) for research items will be reworked in the future, since it has caused confusion.

notes.title: Chinese New Year Update: New Features, More Control, Greater Challenges
notes.content:
I have prepared a major update for Astrosphere, set to release in time for the Chinese New Year. This update expands the game with exciting new features, additional ships, and important improvements that make the gameplay even more immersive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778342/ca051f8e19453134740ad0a3ac9f6f631738832c.png

The new manual weapon mode in particular provides more control in battles and opens up new tactical possibilities.

Additionally, there are numerous optimizations to enhance the gaming experience, as well as some bug fixes that address existing issues.
I'm excited to share this update with you and look forward to your feedback!

New Features  
  
Manual Weapon Mode: You can now switch between automatic and manual firing, giving you more control and adding more dynamism to battles.  
Fire Mode Toggle: Press F to switch between automatic and manual firing.  
Alert State Control: The alert state can now be controlled with the R key.  
Destruction of Civilian Ships: With manual firing enabled, you can now attack civilian ships.  
Wiki Button: A new button in the options menu now provides direct access to the game wiki.  
  

[hr][/hr]  

New Systems and Ships  
  
Medium Cargo Expansion: A new ship system that increases your cargo capacity.  
Light Torpedo MK2: An upgraded weapon system dealing increased damage.  
New Ship – Tianlong: A versatile combat ship with exceptional agility and a powerful reactor core. Inspired by the legend of the celestial dragon, it combines impressive speed with strong defensive systems. Ideal for commanders who favor quick maneuvers and heavy firepower.  
New Ship – Fenghuang: Named after the mythical phoenix, this ship balances offense and defense. It features adaptive shield technology that regenerates after taking damage, along with a sophisticated weapon platform for medium to long-range combat. Perfect for strategic tacticians.  
New Ship – Zhenwu: A heavily armored patrol ship equipped with energy absorption technology. With its durable structure and advanced sensor array, it excels in long-duration deep-space missions. Choosing the Zhenwu means relying on endurance, resilience, and precision counterattacks.  
  

[hr][/hr]  

Update  
  
User interface improvements for a better player experience.  
Adjusted dialogue triggers for planets.  
  

[hr][/hr]  

Bug Fixes  
  
Fixed an issue in the options menu where the button intended to return to the main menu would instead exit the game.  
Fixed a bug that prevented players from recovering resources when replacing ship systems.  
Fixed an issue in the research system where already researched items were not displayed as completed.

notes.title: Update v0.18
notes.content:

notes.title: Update v0.17.1
notes.content:
New Features 

     If there's not enough storage space in the station and you extract more items than you can carry, you'll now have to destroy some cargo before returning to the station.
     Widescreen monitor support: The UI and game world now automatically adapt to any screen resolution.


 Improvements 

     Aluminium and gold are now much more common in asteroids.
     The resource spawn chance in debris fields has been significantly increased.


 Bug Fixes 

     Fixed a bug where the station's cargo hold in the sector was incorrectly limited to 1000.
     The extraction point anomaly is now always clearly visible in front of all objects in the sector.

notes.title: Update v0.17
notes.content:
New Features:


    Photon Jet Engine: A brand-new engine that adds more variety to the selection of ship engines.
    Advanced Ship Systems: New engines such as Ion engine MK2, Ion engine MK3, Photon jet engine MK2, and Photon jet engine MK3 are now available.
    Ship Weight and Thrust: Ships now have specific weights, and engines have thrust values that affect the ship's speed.
    Shipyard Display: Both ship weight and speed are now displayed in the shipyard.
    Credit Production: Credits now continue to be generated while you're inside a sector.


Optimizations:


    UI Update: Tooltips have been reworked to show more information and can now also include thumbnails.
    Pirate Ships: The structural integrity of pirate ships has been updated.
    Nebula Resources: Resource distributions within nebulae have been adjusted.
    Cost Adjustment: The cost of the "Advanced Mining Laser" ship system has been rebalanced.
    Atlas Carrier: The Atlas Carrier now has two additional system slots for engines.


Bugfixes:


    Galactic Trade: Fixed an issue where buying or selling items in bulk (10x) only charged for one item.
    Ship System UI: Fixed an issue where the UI was not responding to player input when installing ship systems.

notes.title: Update v0.16
notes.content:
New 

     I've added new pirate ships that will present a greater challenge. They are stronger, faster, and move in larger groups—so stay alert!
     You can now encounter various collectible nebulae in different sectors. These nebulae contain valuable resources that you can harvest with the right equipment.
     New planets and moons have been added to the game, enhancing the visual diversity and atmosphere of the galaxy.


 Update 

     Space stations now appear more frequently in sectors. This gives you more opportunities to restock or trade without having to search for a station for too long.
     Research costs have been rebalanced. This adjustment ensures a fairer and smoother progression without disrupting the gameplay flow.

     Fixed a bug with the star map where searching for sectors no longer increases the star map level.
     Fixed a bug in the tutorial that prevented progress.

notes.title: Update v0.9.3.1: Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I've just released a new update for Astrosphere that includes some important improvements and bug fixes. Here are the details:


Chinese Characters Update: I've increased the number of Chinese characters in the game to improve readability and accuracy.
Infinite Research Level Bug Fix: A bug where players could achieve infinite research levels has been fixed.
Improvement in Building Ship Systems: It is now no longer possible to build the same ship system multiple times by fast-clicking.

Thank you all for your feedback and support! I'm continuously working on improving the game and look forward to your feedback.

Enjoy the game!
